_title: dossiq: widgets on the Nextcloud dashboard
_note: What you see: the Nextcloud dashboard with the four dossiq widgets: deadline alerts with overdue first, task reminders, My work with open cases, tasks, queue and archival review, stalled cases, and the widget without alerts.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: het dashboard van Nextcloud met de vier widgets van dossiq: termijnsignalen met te laat bovenaan, taakherinneringen, Mijn werk met open zaken, taken, wachtrij en archiefbeoordeling, stilstaande zaken, en de widget zonder signalen.
dossiq: widgets op het Nextcloud-dashboa: dossiq: widgets on the Nextcloud dashboard
Te laat bovenaan, dan wat binnen 3 dagen: Overdue first, then what ends within 3 days; sorted by days
Alle zaken over of bijna over termijn: All cases overdue or nearly overdue
Te laat bovenaan; taken zonder deadline: Overdue first; tasks without a due date are not listed
Advies vragen aan Mobiliteit en verkeer: Ask Mobility and traffic for advice
Uw open taken en zaken, uit dezelfde bro: Your open tasks and cases, from the same source as My work in dossiq
Team Woo en informatie, door niemand opg: Team Woo and information, picked up by nobody
Melding kapot speeltoestel, vernietigen: Broken playground equipment report, destroy on 3 Nov
Open zaken zonder activiteit in 14 dagen: Open cases without activity for 14 days, the longest stall first
De kop opent het dashboard van dossiq, e: The header opens the dossiq dashboard, a row opens the case or the task, the bottom row opens the filtered list. Every widget reads the same source as My work in dossiq; the order and the 3-day threshold are set in the admin settings. A widget with a role you do not have is not offered under Customize.
Zo staat de widget voor een collega zond: This is the widget for a colleague without cases overdue or nearly overdue: no error, no empty list.
Elke open zaak had activiteit in de laat: Every open case had activity in the last 14 days.
